name: Landing page registration card switches roles and displays patient registration
description: On the home landing page, the user can click Get Your Health ID to scroll to the registration card and switch between role tabs.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Get Your Health ID' button in the top navigation bar
Click the 'For Doctor' tab button on the registration card
Click the 'For Patient' tab button on the registration card
Verify the registration card displays the 'Name on Aadhaar' field and 'Register for E-KAVACH' heading
